build_head_from_config: build a ClassyHead from a config dict using the build_head factory function
register_custom_head: register a custom head class with the register_head decorator for use with build_head
test_build_head: test that build_head creates a head with the correct unique_id from config
test_forward_pass: test the forward pass of a built head with a random input tensor
test_identity_head: test that the identity head returns the same tensor as input
